format: Edited walkthrough from genuine app screenshots and saved execution/training receipts

scenes.text: A customer clicks once. Your webhook arrives twice. This is Reflex: verified work becomes a model your agent can use.
scenes.title: One click. Two orders.

scenes.text: The same operation creates two orders and deducts inventory twice. This sample incident runs real code. These are saved execution results.
scenes.title: The retry becomes a second order.

scenes.text: Two checks fail. Repeated deliveries must preserve the original outcome, while different orders must still work. Execution gives the agent its target.
scenes.title: Two checks expose the broken retry.

scenes.text: River writes this repair. It recognizes the replay before changing inventory and returns the original response. The checkout repair took about fifteen seconds.
scenes.title: Recognize the replay before changing inventory.

scenes.text: One order. Four checks pass. The model produced code; execution determined whether it worked. The repair and its evidence stay together.
scenes.title: One order. Four checks pass.

scenes.text: River proposes, execution verifies, and verified repairs train the model: rejection sampling fine tuning. Twenty four generated tasks produced twenty three River requests and nineteen verified repairs. Five accepted repairs bring the training set to twenty four.
scenes.title: Only verified repairs train the model.

scenes.text: The latest River run completed forty eight weight updates on twenty four verified examples. It saved version four, our own trained specialist, ready to use and export.
scenes.title: Your own specialist. Ready for the next task.

scenes.text: In our earlier version three comparison, all three passed four held out failures. The set is too easy to show a learning advantage.
scenes.title: Earlier v3 comparison: four held-out failures.

scenes.text: Now UFO uses our own trained specialist. Its repair tool calls River version four. In this recorded SDK run, stock replay moved from two of four to four of four checks in five point seven seconds. This was a training case.
scenes.title: UFO called our own trained specialist.
scenes.presentation: edited saved receipt with sequential stage highlights
scenes.stage_highlights: Illustrative progression through recorded tool/model/verification; not original elapsed timing.

scenes.text: UFO now calls our trained model to do the job. Your failures become your dataset. Your dataset becomes your model.
scenes.title: Your failures become your dataset. Your dataset becomes your model.
